mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.25%, it signals tightening bias that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 0.25%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in housing starts signals strong labor market and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic expansion accelerates.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in industrial production signals weakening supply chains and rising recession risks, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle periods with declining INDPRO, or INDPRO Rank IC in late-cycle is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate trend consistently signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with rising UNRATE, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1,650,000 units, it signals robust consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with HOUST > 1650.0, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate and decline in industrial production signals monetary tightening coupled with supply constraints, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as inflation and recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and declining INDPRO fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery phase, a declining unemployment rate below 4.0% signals strengthening consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
